player_0.content: New plan: I incorrectly classified the error as "Modifiers or Adjectives" because I focused on the change from "incomplete" to "complete." However, the definition of "Negation or Antonyms" explicitly includes "change comparatives to their antonyms," and changing a word with a negative prefix (un-) to its positive opposite is a direct antonymic shift. In this specific task, the inversion of "incomplete" to "complete" is best categorized as an antonym error. Next time, when I see a modifier changed to its direct opposite (especially involving negation prefixes), I will prioritize selecting option (C) Negation or Antonyms over (A).
